div.l: Ne study not / lay on hond euery man
Anon to drawen euery wyght began
And shortly to telle as it was
Were it be auenture fortune or caas
The soth is thys the cut fyl on the knyght
Of whyche ful blythe and glad is euery wyght
And telle he muste as it was reson
As ye haue herd what nedyth wordys moo
And whan thys good man sawe that it was soo
As he that was wyse and obedyent
To kepe hys forward by hys fre assent
He sayde sithnes I shal begynne the game
What welcom be cut a goddys name
Now late vs ryde ⁊and herkyn what I say
And wyth that word we riden forth our way
And he began wyth right a mery chere
And sayde anone hys tale as ye shul here
